slides.subtitle: Build your own CV website this afternoon. Free.

slides.label: This took an afternoon. And £0.
slides.caption: Our example site for a made-up job hunter. Works on a phone too.

slides.label: Why bother
slides.detail: 141 applications for every graduate job (Institute of Student Employers). And 3 in 4 UK recruiters think AI writes at least half the CVs they see (TestGorilla).
slides.start: When every CV looks polished, proof stands out.

slides.label: Step 1: Gather three things
slides.detail: Your CV. Three results with a number ("grew followers from 2,000 to 12,000"). One line on the job you want and where.

slides.label: Step 2: Ask an AI to build it
slides.detail: Open Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini (free plans work) and paste:
slides.start: Fill in the brackets with your CV and target role.
slides.quote: Build me a one-page CV website as a single index.html file. Here is my CV: [paste]. I want [role] in [town]. Bold headline, three results with numbers, experience, skills, buttons to download my CV and email me. Works on a phone. No home address. Ask me if unsure.

slides.label: Step 3: Save it, open it, tweak it
slides.detail: Paste the code into a file called index.html in a new folder, with your CV PDF beside it. Double-click to open it in your browser.
slides.start: Ask for changes in plain words: "make the headline bigger".

slides.label: Step 4: Put it online, free
slides.detail: Go to Netlify Drop and drag your folder onto the page. You get a live link in seconds. Claim it with a free account so it stays up.
slides.start: GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages work too.

slides.label: Show proof, not promises
slides.caption: Three results with numbers do more than a page of adjectives.

slides.label: Step 5: Put the link everywhere
slides.detail: Top of your CV. Your LinkedIn contact info and Featured section. Your email signature. Every application with a portfolio box.
slides.start: Optional: a yourname.co.uk domain for a small yearly fee.

slides.label: One thing to watch
slides.detail: Only claim what you can talk through in an interview. Leave your home address and personal phone off the page. Read every line the AI writes.
slides.start: On a CV site, accuracy is the whole point.
